positionReference.basis: The museum group photograph identifies the central low log White Kitchen, green hip, pale chimney, left wooden door and two divided white windows. Ordinary aerial imagery shows the matching separate green roof in the service courtyard behind Tolstoy House, with the southwest flower bed matching the ground photo. The retained PMTiles and current OSM neighborhood map omit this footprint; reject toilet way167382259 as unrelated. Photo-derived roof center[37.526028,54.076367] and9.6x7m plan are author estimates, about5m positional/15degree facing uncertainty, not an OSM or surveyed footprint. X southeast follows the visible roof; front+Z southwest faces the flower bed. Existing mapped buildings stay independent.

members.title: Icehouse

positionReference.basis: Two ordinary courtyard photos show the same independent low log outbuilding with steep weathered board gable roof, horizontal timber gable, small triangular vent and braced low door immediately beside the kitchen. The aerial roof northeast of the kitchen supplies approximate center[37.526115,54.076448] and southwest-facing gable axis. Assignment as the icehouse rather than woodshed remains an explicit estate-context inference: the photographs are grouped under kitchen and do not label this outbuilding individually. This is an original specific exterior interpretation, not a generic icehouse preset. Standard PMTiles/current OSM omit its footprint; own or replace no native building. Position about5m/facing20degrees are author estimates, not measured bounds.
